item.text: {"analysis":"The host completed training and independent evaluation successfully, reporting macro-average validation HR@10 of 0.5637 across all four categories. Category HR@10 was 0.595 for Movies_and_TV, 0.645 for Industrial_and_Scientific, 0.345 for Electronics, and 0.670 for CDs_and_Vinyl. Electronics was the weakest category. Allocated GPU time was 373.13 seconds. These results establish successful execution, but no baseline comparison or individual-member results were supplied, so they do not establish an improvement from the preference gate, VAE, or fusion.","code_summary":"Per category, trains a two-block causal SASRec with a learned gate blending sequential features and cumulative mean-history preferences, using cross-entropy against 16 sampled negatives per positive. Independently trains a denoising MultVAE on binary whole-history item vectors with an annealed KL penalty. Each member selects its checkpoint using validation HR@10, breaking ties with NDCG@10. Inference averages reciprocal candidate ranks with offset 60. The generated working/predict.py preserves all four dataset routes and reloads the matching architectures and checkpoints. Data comes from GAGC_DATA_DIR, and artifacts are written beneath the trial directory."}
